name: ORO AI
long_description:
ORO AI is an applied AI research lab. We build high-fidelity simulation environments grounded in real data to teach AI the tacit knowledge required to run safe and profitable autonomous businesses.

Our first public benchmark, SMB Bench, puts a frontier model in charge of a produce wholesaler's buying desk for a simulated 90-day quarter, where shortages and supplier failures have delayed effects. The report, leaderboard and every run are available: https://oroagents.com/benchmarks/smb-bench

SMB Bench is a step toward our longer-term goal of having AI as an independent economic actor that can safely run profitable businesses.
one_liner: RL environments & simulations for autonomous businesses.
